gloss: to make fun of; to look down on; to belittle

definitions.gloss: to make fun of; to look down on; to belittle
definitions.explanation: To treat someone as slightly stupid or inferior, often with a condescending attitude. Implies a mild but insulting degree of mockery.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}を{小馬鹿|こばか}にするな。
{小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような{態度|たいど}を{取|と}る。
あの{上司|じょうし}はいつも{部下|ぶか}を{小馬鹿|こばか}にした{言|い}い{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: That boss always speaks to subordinates in a belittling way.

examples.japanese: {小馬鹿|こばか}にされて、とても{悔|くや}しかった。
examples.english: I was made fun of and felt very frustrated.

notes:
Expresses a mild but clear form of mockery or condescension. The {小|こ} prefix softens {馬鹿|ばか} (fool/stupid), but paradoxically this makes the expression more cutting — it implies the speaker considers the target not worth taking seriously.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にする: to belittle, make fun of
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にされる: to be made fun of (passive)
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような{笑|わら}い: a mocking laugh
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような{態度|たいど}: a condescending attitude
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にした{口調|くちょう}: a sneering tone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {馬鹿|ばか}にする: to make a fool of — stronger and more directly insulting
- {見下|みくだ}す: to look down on — more about perceived superiority
- {嘲笑|ちょうしょう}する: to ridicule — more formal/literary

FORMS:
{小|こ} (small, slight) + {馬鹿|ばか} (fool) + にする (to treat as). The {小|こ} prefix creates a sense of dismissive, casual contempt.
